'''Leonia Tavira's palace''' in [[Yumfla]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Susevfi]] was the residence of the local [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Unidentified Imperial governor (Suarbi system)|governor]] until the renegade Imperial [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] [[Leonia Tavira]] [[Death/Legends|killed]] him and took the [[palace]] as the headquarters of her [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] organization, the [[Invids]].
